ccs-conduct-q-032.reason: One correct answer, grounded in Rule 13(2), CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. The ₹7,500 Group 'C' wedding-gift reporting threshold is the rule's own figure (against ₹15,000 for Group 'B' and ₹25,000 for Group 'A'); the ₹17,000 gift value is deliberately chosen to sit above the applicable threshold. Distractors ('never report', 'return outright since sanction is barred', 'report to CVC') are plausible workplace misconceptions, none secretly correct — Rule 13(2) needs only a post-facto report, no prior sanction, and to Government, not CVC.
